abstract: We study delayed local credit assignment for causal Transformer pretraining without a backward pass—executing zero reverse matrix pullbacks ($\mathbf{e}_{\text{in}} = \mathbf{e}_{\text{out}} W$), zero VJP helpers, and zero same-step error relays inside `with torch.no_grad():`. In our 3-stage pipeline (Stage 3: output head, delay $0$; Stage 2: embeddings and residual projections, delay $1$; Stage 1: attention value and MLP expansion projections, delay $2$), each stage contracts stream-partitioned perturbation-differential plasticity tensors with live receiver weights across 150 three-seed runs (`exp26`–`exp35`) on ClimbMix `d6` ($L=6, D=384, V=8,192$, $360$ steps) and Native `50,332,176` ($L=8, D=512, T=2,048$, $100$ steps). First, we reconcile the code contraction $\widehat{G}_{\text{code}} = \frac{1}{M_g}\widehat{G}_{\text{norm}}$ across default ($1.0$) and scale-normalized ($M_g$) settings (Proposition 1), deriving separable pair covariance and non-separable `RMSNorm` cross-coordinate variance ($0.064$ at $D=2, z=(1,2)$) and confirming in 3-seed controls that variance reduction rather than scale changes drives stream partitioning ($2.5939 \to 2.2281$ DEV BPB). Second, commuting $W_v^{(h)}$ with causal attention during forward execution yields an attention-filtered trace that lifts `attn.c_v` cosine alignment $8.2\times$ ($+0.1104 \to +0.9069$, Proposition 2). Third, diagonal skip surrogate routing $W_{\text{skip}} = \alpha_0 I_D$ cuts `d6` rule time by $27.4\%$ (Proposition 3). Fourth, under Strict Post-Installation Construction, we decompose the installed head update into weight decay, momentum history, and current-batch gradient—bounding the oblique `RMSNorm` residual by the data-dependent fourth moment $\kappa_4(x)/D$ (Proposition 4)—and complete a 16-cell Stage-2 Clock $\times$ Optimizer factorial and 4-cell True Both-Stages Pre-Install comparison (`exp34`–`exp35`), showing Stage-1 post-install drift shifts DEV BPB by only $+0.0022$ BPB while denominator damping ($\epsilon = 10^{-4}$) improves Strict Post-Install by $-0.0279$ BPB to $2.1273 \pm 0.0002$ DEV BPB ($2.1195 \pm 0.0005$ under True Pre-Install). Over 100 steps on Native `50.3M`, backward-free WM reaches $1.9337 \pm 0.0004$ (pre-install) and $1.9361 \pm 0.0004$ (post-install), outperforming `AdamW` backpropagation ($1.9734 \pm 0.0139$) while trailing full `Muon+AdamW` ($1.6989 \pm 0.0005$).
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: 1. Reconciled Proposition 1 with the implemented code contraction G_hat_code(G; scale_factor) = (1/N) sum_g R_g Z_g = (scale_factor/M_g) G_hat_norm(G), deriving the conditional mean (scale_factor/M_g) (1/N) sum_n a_n x_n (giving 0.5 under scale_factor=1 and 1.0 under scale_factor=M_g on N=4, G=2, M_g=2) and covariance scaled by (scale_factor/M_g)^2, verified by exhaustive 2^N enumeration. Executed 3-seed scale-normalized controls (scale_factor = float(M_g), exp35 Part A) on d6 showing learning trajectories match default scale_factor=1 (2.6097 -> 2.3361 -> 2.3008 vs 2.5939 -> 2.3364 -> 2.2966 across G in {1, 64, 256}; and 2.2539 ± 0.0013 vs 2.2541 ± 0.0013 at G=64 under Pre-Polar Muon). 2. Added Proposition 1(c) distinguishing separable channels (Stage 1) from non-separable RMSNorm interfaces (Stage 2), deriving exact single-token (M_g=1) conditional mean and cross-coordinate variance a_{n,i}^2 x_{n,i}^2 (D - x_{n,i}^2) / (D^2 rms(z_n)^2) ||h_n||^2, verified on the reviewer's D=2, z=(1,2) example (variance 0.064) and exhaustive 2^D check at D=6 in verify_paper5.py. 3. Replaced unrestricted O(1/D) scaling in Proposition 4 with the exact data-dependent fourth-moment bound kappa_4(x)/D (kappa_4(x) = (1/D) sum_i x_i^4), proving both the non-vanishing sparse counterexample x=sqrt(D/5)(1,2,0,...,0) (ratio 0.0576, kappa_4/D = 0.68 for all D >= 2) and the O(1/D) decay under bounded fourth moments, and reporting the empirical d6 kurtosis measurement kappa_4(x_final) = 2.9398 (bound 0.007656, empirical ratio 0.007458, exp35 Part 0). Restricted exact radial collinearity to row-isotropic preconditioning and showed coordinate variation in entrywise moments is damped by eps=1e-4. 4. Executed exp35 Part B completing all 16 cells of the Stage-2 Pre-Install vs. Strict Post-Install x Pooling x Momentum x Damping cube (adding row_iso_b09_eps1e8 = 2.1662 and row_iso_b05_eps1e4 = 2.1296) and ran True Both-Stages Pre-Install ((t-1,t-1,t)/(t-2,t-1 [pre-Stage2],t), exp35 Part B2) across all 4 entrywise cells (2.1341, 2.1418, 2.1195, 2.1229 DEV BPB). Reconciled Stage-1 clock labels in ledgers to (t-2, t [post-Stage2], t) for Stage-2 Pre-Install. 5. Corrected Dust [9] description (tokenwise perturbations rewarded by loss changes and attention-output estimates), clarified that the ledger records declared trainer metadata, and presented rare-token dilution and momentum trajectory mechanisms as hypotheses.
title: Three-Stage Delayed Eligibility-Trace Weight Maximization for Backward-Free Transformer Pretraining: Stream Partitioning, Forward Attention-Filtered Value Traces, and Post-Installation Credit Debiasing
